name: nb18_13_marker_height_inner_cell
description: Extra (NB3, test 2): the marker height is terrain.GetAltitude(px, pz) at the inner cell's centre, the point the prop is placed at; the connection cell is never used. Road at (-1, 5) in a 64x64 city: inner cell (0, 5), centre (8, 88) at altitude 300 (the connection cell's centre (-8, 88) is at 250) -> the marker at (8, 300, 88). Highway at (5, -1): inner cell (5, 0), centre (88, 8) at 310 (the connection cell's centre (88, -8) at 0) -> 310 + 15.5 = 325.5.
